findings.subject: sidebar
findings.summary: An icon-collapsed sidebar (collapsible="icon") renders its menu buttons with no accessible name.
findings.evidence: sidebar.css:545-549 hides every non-sr-only label span with display:none; lucide icons are aria-hidden; the tooltip prop (sidebar.tsx:601-611) is a Base UI tooltip, which does not name its trigger. No test or baseline covers the collapsed rail.
findings.fix: Hide the label visually (sr-only clip) instead of display:none in the icon state, or have SidebarMenuButton set aria-label from tooltip/label when collapsed; add a test that every collapsed menu button has a name, and a collapsed-rail baseline.

verified.reason: Reproduced from source. In icon mode, sidebar.css:545-549 sets display:none on every non-sr-only child span of .a63-Sidebar-menu-button, which removes the label from the accessibility tree. The tooltip path (sidebar.tsx:601-611) adds no aria-label or aria-describedby: grep finds no 'describedby' anywhere in @base-ui/react@1.6.0 tooltip/. Base UI's own tooltip.md:391 says the trigger needs its own aria-label. SidebarMenuButton never copies the tooltip string into aria-label. One small error in the evidence: a Collapsible story does exist (sidebar.stories.tsx:146, collapsible:'icon', baseline ui-react-sidebar-collapsible), but it reuses Playground.render, and the only icon-mode test (sidebar.test.tsx:297-304) checks inert, not the accessible name.

findings.subject: sidebar
findings.summary: In right-to-left layouts the menu action and badge overlap the start of the menu label.
findings.evidence: sidebar.css:555 (.a63-Sidebar-menu-action right:0) and :605 (.a63-Sidebar-menu-badge right:0.25rem) are physical, while the space reserved for them is logical (css:493 padding-inline-end). Tooltip side="right" (sidebar.tsx:607) is physical too. check:craft passes because it does not check inset properties.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-end for the action and badge, and side "inline-end" (or derive from dir) for the tooltip; extend check:craft physical-properties to left/right insets; add an RTL story.

verified.reason: Reproduced from source. .a63-Sidebar-menu-action uses right:0 (sidebar.css:555) and .a63-Sidebar-menu-badge uses right:0.25rem (css:605). The room reserved for them is padding-inline-end (css:493), so in RTL the padding moves to the left while the action and badge stay on the right, on top of the start of the label. The tooltip has side="right" hard-coded (sidebar.tsx:607). The CSS has no [dir=rtl] or :dir() override for either element. The group action, by contrast, already uses inset-inline-end (css:381), so the logical pattern is in use elsewhere in the same file.

findings.subject: sidebar-nav-tree
findings.summary: The Themes visual baseline is broken: it captures 1 of the 8 theme/mode combinations.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-sidebarnavtree-themes-chromium-linux.png is 1280x60084; a row-luminance profile finds content only in the first ~150px (modern/light). The story wraps each cell in SidebarProvider, whose .a63-Sidebar-wrapper keeps min-height:100svh (sidebar.css:38); the Sidebar Themes story overrides it (minHeight:0) and renders fine.
findings.fix: Pass style={{ minHeight: 0 }} to SidebarProvider in CompactTree (sidebar-nav-tree.stories.tsx:227), regenerate the baseline, and add a check that rejects baselines taller than a sane bound.

verified.reason: sips gives 1280x60084 for ui-react-sidebarnavtree-themes-chromium-linux.png. In a downscaled strip only the first panel near the top shows content; crops at y=9000 and later are plain white, so the dark-mode panels (which would be dark) are missing. The Themes story (sidebar-nav-tree.stories.tsx:267-293) renders CompactTree, which wraps each cell in a bare <SidebarProvider> (line 227) with no minHeight override. The wrapper therefore keeps min-height:100svh (sidebar.css:38). The Sidebar stories pass style={{minHeight:0}} (sidebar.stories.tsx:108,163,231).

findings.subject: marquee
findings.summary: With its default props the marquee moves forever with no way to pause it, failing WCAG 2.2.2 (level A).
findings.evidence: marquee.tsx:27-28 default pauseOnHover=false, paused=false; marquee.css:39 infinite animation; focus pauses only with pauseOnHover (css:52-55); only prefers-reduced-motion stops it (css:75-85).
findings.fix: Pause on hover and focus-within by default (make pauseOnHover default true, or always pause on focus-within), and document or offer a pause control for strips that run longer than 5 seconds; test it.

verified.reason: marquee.tsx:27-28 defaults pauseOnHover and paused to false. marquee.css:39 runs an infinite linear animation. The hover and focus-within pause rules (css:52-55) apply only with data-pause-on-hover. Only prefers-reduced-motion stops the motion (css:75-85, plus the scroll region at tsx:40-43). The component ships no pause control, and its contract and docs give no guidance on WCAG 2.2.2. So a default <Marquee> moves indefinitely next to other content and the user cannot pause it.

findings.subject: sidebar

findings.subject: sidebar-nav-tree
findings.summary: Long labels cannot be revealed on touch.
findings.evidence: Ticker reveal is hover/focus only (text-ticker.css:26-29); nav rows are touch targets with no long-press reveal.
findings.fix: Allow labels to wrap to two lines on coarse pointers, or reveal on the active row.

findings.subject: app-view
findings.summary: AppView names regions with music-app defaults and separates panels by fill alone.
findings.evidence: Defaults panelLabel="Library", bottomBarLabel="Player" (app-view.tsx:94,101) announce wrong names in other apps; the rail is an <aside> named "Navigation" (tsx:153), a complementary landmark rather than a nav; inset chrome draws rail/panel/main/aside as background cards (app-view.css:162-168) with no forced-colors border.
findings.fix: Drop the product-specific defaults (require a label when the slot is used, or default to neutral names like "Sidebar"/"Bottom bar"), render the rail as <nav> or let the caller choose, and add a forced-colors outline to inset cards.

findings.subject: app-view
findings.summary: topBarSpan="main" renders two elements with data-slot="app-view-body".
findings.evidence: app-view.tsx:150 and :166.
findings.fix: Give the inner wrapper its own slot name (e.g. app-view-content-body) and add it to the contract.

findings.subject: app-view
findings.summary: The component PhoneWith* baselines are taken at desktop width.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-appview-phone-with-tab-bar-chromium-linux.png and the other PhoneWith* PNGs are 1280x900; only the templates baselines are at phone width.
findings.fix: Rename the stories with the Phone suffix the visual runner uses for a 390px viewport (as DarkSidebarPhone does), and regenerate.

findings.subject: table
findings.summary: A wide table cannot be scrolled from the keyboard, and selected rows have no accessible or forced-colors cue.
findings.evidence: table.css:27 overflow-x:auto on a container that is not focusable or named (table.tsx:39-45); selection is data-state="selected" with a background (css:96-99), no aria-selected and no forced-colors rule.
findings.fix: Make the container focusable with a name when it overflows (tabIndex=0, role="region", aria-label from a prop or the caption), document aria-selected on selectable rows, and add a forced-colors rule for selected rows.

findings.subject: table
findings.summary: Compact density does not tighten a default-size table.
findings.evidence: table.css:59-60 head height 2.5rem, padding-inline 0.625rem; :75 cell padding 0.625rem; only size="sm" reads a row token (css:114-116).
findings.fix: Derive default head height and cell padding from row/control tokens times --a63-density-scale.

findings.subject: table
findings.summary: Numeric columns have no end-aligned, tabular-figure affordance.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-table-themes-chromium-linux.png shows the Amount column start-aligned; table.css has no numeric cell rule.
findings.fix: Add a numeric cell option (data-align="end" + tabular-nums) and use it in the stories.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Calendar selection is always the brand fill, with no tone axis, against the neutral-by-default selection rule.
findings.evidence: calendar.css:204-207 selected = --a63-action-primary; AGENTS.md rule 5: selection is neutral by default, tone="accent" opt-in; Table and Sidebar expose tone (table.json tones, sidebar.json menuButtonTones).
findings.fix: Add tone (neutral default, accent) to calendar.json and the recipe, or record an explicit exception in the contract if YZ wants the brand fill here.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: The calendar contract lists 15 slots but only the root carries data-slot.
findings.evidence: calendar.json slots calendar-months ... calendar-day-button; calendar.tsx:92-113 maps rdp parts to classes only, data-slot only on the root (tsx:153, test:14).
findings.fix: Set data-slot on each part through rdp components/classNames, or trim the contract to what the DOM carries.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: The selected date and today are invisible in forced colors.
findings.evidence: calendar.css:204-207 (fill) and 248-260 (dot via ::after background); no forced-colors rule.
findings.fix: Add a forced-colors rule: Highlight background with HighlightText for selected, and a border or underline for today.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Day cells are 36px on coarse pointers outside the phone form factor.
findings.evidence: calendar.css:10-14 --cell-size max(control-height-lg x density, min-size); height-lg = 9 units, min-size 2rem on touch (atom63 token).
findings.fix: Floor the cell at --a63-control-min-target on pointer: coarse (7 x 44px = 308px still fits a phone).

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Day names add English words and the month dropdown ignores the locale prop.
findings.evidence: calendar.tsx:67-68 "Today, " and ", selected"; tsx:155 toLocaleString('default', { month: 'short' }).
findings.fix: Take these words from rdp labels/locale (or props), and format the month with options.locale.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: The calendar guidance in the CLI is generic form advice.
findings.evidence: pnpm -s atom63 component calendar: "Pair controls with persistent labels and explain errors beside the affected field"; nothing on range mode, a date-picker popover, or locale.
findings.fix: Write calendar-specific guidance in the contract: single vs range, composing with Popover + Input, locale and weekStartsOn.

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: A caller ref on Carousel breaks its RTL detection and cursor indicator, and a caller onClick on the nav buttons replaces scrolling.
findings.evidence: carousel.tsx:248-250 ref={containerRef} then {...props}; RTL read tsx:90-93 and cursor rect tsx:165-166 use containerRef; CarouselPrevious/Next onClick then {...props} (tsx:362-364, 385-387).
findings.fix: Merge refs (useMergedRefs) and compose onClick (call the caller's, then scroll unless defaultPrevented); test both.

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: Carousel misses parts of the APG carousel pattern and hijacks arrow keys inside slides.
findings.evidence: Slides have no "n of m" name (tsx:309-317); off-screen slides stay tabbable; onKeyDownCapture on the region preventDefaults ArrowLeft/Right from any descendant, including text inputs (tsx:129-143,244); vertical carousels still use Left/Right.
findings.fix: Name slides "Slide n of m" by default, set inert on slides out of view, ignore key events from editable targets and handle them in bubble phase, and use Up/Down when vertical; add a pattern binding in apps/storybook/a11y/patterns.test.ts.

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: Slide transitions still animate under reduced motion, and the dots disappear in forced colors.
findings.evidence: Only the cursor honours useReducedMotion (tsx:113,270); Embla's duration is untouched. Dots are ::before backgrounds (carousel.css:192-207) and the default shape marks the current dot by colour alone (carousel.json dotShapes description).
findings.fix: Pass a near-instant duration to Embla when reduced motion is on; add a forced-colors rule (CanvasText dots, Highlight for the current one).

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: In light modes the slide has no surface, while dark modes draw a card.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-carousel-themes-chromium-linux.png: modern/retro/terminal light show no slide boundary; all dark cells show a card.
findings.fix: YZ to decide whether the slide surface should read the same in both modes.

findings.subject: marquee
findings.summary: Marquee uses boolean props for its orientation axis.
findings.evidence: marquee.tsx:11,15 reverse?: boolean, vertical?: boolean; marquee.json lists orientations ["horizontal","vertical"].
findings.fix: Add orientation (horizontal/vertical) from the contract, keep vertical as a deprecated alias.

findings.subject: marquee
findings.summary: The marquee guidance does not tell builders it needs a pause.
findings.evidence: pnpm -s atom63 component marquee guidance is generic ("Keep the utility's semantic purpose explicit instead of relying on visual treatment alone").
findings.fix: State the WCAG 2.2.2 requirement and the pause options (pauseOnHover, paused bound to a control).

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: A caller ref on a marquee TextTicker stops it from ever measuring or scrolling.
findings.evidence: text-ticker.tsx:111 ref={containerRef} then {...props} at :117; measureOverflow returns early without the container (tsx:51-55).
findings.fix: Merge the caller ref with containerRef; test it.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: Under reduced motion, hovering or focusing an overflowing ticker hides the readable copy and shows clipped, faded text.
findings.evidence: text-ticker.css:61-65 still sets the static copy to opacity 0 on hover/focus-within; the reduced-motion block (css:118-139) restores it only for autoplay and leaves the edge mask (css:26-37) on.
findings.fix: Under prefers-reduced-motion keep the static copy and drop the mask in every activation state, and offer the full text another way (title or tooltip).

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: The resting marquee label shows its first letter faded by the edge mask.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-textticker-themes-chromium-linux.png: "N" of "Now playing" is faded in all 8 cells; the start-edge mask (css:30-36) applies while the text sits at translateX(0).
findings.fix: Mask only the end edge until the track has moved, or start the mask after the delay.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: The text ticker scrolls the wrong way in right-to-left text.
findings.evidence: text-ticker.css:109-116 always translates negative X; there is no :dir(rtl) rule, unlike marquee.css:24-26.
findings.fix: Add a direction variable flipped under :dir(rtl), as Marquee does, and an RTL story.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: On touch, truncated ticker text can never be revealed.
findings.evidence: Activation is :hover or :focus-within on the ticker itself (text-ticker.css:26-29,61-63,101-104).
findings.fix: Reveal on the active/pressed row or allow wrapping on coarse pointers; document it.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: The text ticker guidance does not say when the reveal triggers.
findings.evidence: pnpm -s atom63 component text-ticker guidance is generic boilerplate.
findings.fix: Document hover/focus/autoplay triggers, the touch limit and the reduced-motion behaviour.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: No test covers overflow measurement, activation, reduced motion or refs.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/text-ticker/text-ticker.test.tsx has 5 tests on variant, class and style only.
findings.fix: Add tests with a mocked ResizeObserver/scrollWidth for data-overflowing, autoplay, and ref forwarding.
